title: Restricted Hupsel SWETR=0 PMdirect typed application composition

implementation_decision.principle: Consume the admitted F-APP03 postimage; do not reproduce or fit PMdirect equations in F-APP04.
implementation_decision.root_uptake: Add a PMdirect-specific transparent binding from pmdirect_swetr0_interval_result_t potential_transpiration_cm_per_day into the existing canonical crop_root_uptake_input_t while preserving and validating root geometry exactly as the admitted SWETR=1 binding does.
implementation_decision.surface_evaporation: Add a PMdirect-specific transparent demand binding from pmdirect_swetr0_daily_result_t potential_soil_evaporation_cm_per_day and potential_pond_evaporation_cm_per_day into the existing surface_evaporation_demand_t. Do not duplicate candidate/committed-state materialization logic and do not modify the admitted SWETR=1 runtime materialization module.
implementation_decision.net_rain: No new downstream rain contract is authorized by the targeted inspection. Keep pmdirect_swetr0_interval_result_t net_rain_cm_per_day in the qualified F-APP03 postimage until an existing typed receiving seam is demonstrated; do not invent one in F-APP04.

validation_policy: Reject upstream PMdirect diagnostics unless status is PMDIRECT_SWETR0_OK and the required daily/interval result-produced flag is true.
For root uptake, neutralize incoming potential_transpiration before validating existing root geometry, then bind the F-APP03 interval postimage and validate the assembled canonical input.
For surface demand, require finite non-negative F-APP03 daily demands before producing surface_evaporation_demand_t.
On rejection return zero/default output objects and explicit diagnostics; never substitute defaults for missing scientific authority.
next_permitted_action: Implement only the two transparent PMdirect typed bindings described above, add owner tests for exact mapping and fail-closed behavior, and qualify them without modifying existing SWETR=1 binding/runtime files. Revisit net-rain application only if a pre-existing typed receiving contract is found by a bounded targeted inspection.
exclusions: modification of admitted SWETR=1 reference-ET process or binding/runtime modules
